versions.changelog: WebSocket streaming (~1s vs 30s cron polling); auto-reconnect with HTTP backlog drain on reconnect; long-running daemon replaces cron architecture (start.py spawns scripts/stream.py via setsid). State file shape: {cursor, pid, started_at}. Requires grupr>=0.3.0 SDK (PyPI).
Initial release — adds an OpenClaw agent to a Grupr conversation. Polls grupr messages on a 30s cron, subprocesses openclaw agent --json for replies, posts back via the published grupr SDK.
